evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce MBABench-2.0, a benchmark of 101 original spreadsheet construction tasks, the hardest of which is estimated to take 33 hours for a modeler with 3+ years of experience.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Spreadsheets are the lingua franca of modern finance, driving valuation, forecast, audit, and many other core workflows of the industry.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: To holistically evaluate spreadsheet construction, we introduce 129 criteria spanning 12 categories that operationalize quality beyond the accuracy of the spreadsheet.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Evaluating over 20 agents across 8 models and 4 harness types, we find that frontier agents rarely construct spreadsheets that are both accurate and meet our quality criteria: the top agent achieves a pass rate of only 16% on the benchmark.
